column1: # rac3-pal's tables/split_places.tsv at NTSC-U's places (config/us/levels/functions.tsv): the
# multiplayer maps' copies of the font width wrapper (func_L01_00410820, PAL func_L01_00412E50)
# call another routine, whose int their callers read in $v0.
# function
# (The class type getters and the other 8-byte leaves the catalogue used to file one row along are filed
# by their callers' call sites since rac3-decomp 7453660c: no split needed.)
# The draw callback lists' adders (80 bytes each, one fingerprint): in levels 03, 11, 16 and 23
# NTSC-U's catalogue puts the row of func_L01_00402560 (the second list's adder, count 0x001DFA10
# on Veldin) at each level's adder of the fourth list (the count its runner, func_L01_004026F0's
# place, reads: Starship Phoenix's 0x003EFF28 counts at 0x001DF38C), and the row of
# func_L01_004026A0 (the fourth's) at a routine of the same shape over another count (0x001D6778).
# Run as Veldin's second-list adder through the level's data pairs, a callback added there raised
# the fourth list's count but wrote its function elsewhere, and the runner called address 0
# ("call to code address 0x00000000" in levels 3, 11, 16 and 23). Each place is its own variant.
# The Vid-comic password panel's byte getter and clear on the Phoenix (03) and in the Insomniac
# Museum (24), folded by fingerprint into func_L01_004C78E0 and func_L01_004D75F8, and the real twin
# of func_L01_004C78E0 (the flag func_L01_004C78D8 sets: the help box's) folded into
# func_L01_004D4C50: the panel read the help box's flag and opened on every arrival. As in
# rac3-pal's split_places.tsv; the real twins are their rows' places (hostgen.json "more_places").
func_L01_004D4C50
func_L01_004D75F8
func_L01_004C78E0

# flag's setter, 0x004594C8) and its real twin (0x004A9230, the byte func_L01_004C78E0 at 0x004A9238
# reads) into func_L01_004D4B48. As in rac3-pal's split_places.tsv; the real twin is its row's place
